author: Linnaeus, 1758
summary: 자작나무·전나무·소나무 숲에 사는 흔한 겨울철새로, 전국에서 볼 수 있다. 주로 식물성 먹이를 먹고 여름에는 곤충의 어른벌레와 애벌레를 먹는다. 번식지에서는 알을 6~7개 낳는다. 세계적으로는 구북구 전역에 분포한다.

points.en: black head and back on breeding male
bill black in summer, pale yellow in winter

sexes.male: 여름깃은 머리와 등이 검고, 겨울깃은 머리가 연한 흑갈색에 회색 줄 두 개가 있다.
sexes.female: 수컷 겨울깃과 비슷하나 머리가 연한 갈색이고, 멱·가슴·어깨의 황갈색이 수컷보다 연하다. 등은 수컷처럼 황갈색에 검은 반점이 있다.

art.subject: Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), adult male in winter plumage, as seen in Korean woodland from October to March: head and nape dark brownish-black, heavily fringed grey-brown, with greyish sides to the nape forming two pale stripes; mantle blackish with buff fringes; narrow white rump; throat, breast and shoulders bright orange; belly white; rear flanks orange-buff with small black spots; wings black with an orange-buff upper wing bar, a paler buff to whitish lower bar and a small white patch at the base of the primaries; tail black, notched. Conical bill pale yellow with a dark tip; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a birch branch, side view
art.scene: Korean winter woodland of birch and pine; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, winter (October–March), side view perched: brownish-black head scaled grey-brown, greyish nape sides, bright orange throat, breast and shoulders, white belly, black-spotted orange-buff flanks, two pale wing bars, pale yellow bill with a dark tip

adult male, breeding plumage (seen on spring passage in April–May), side view perched: glossy black head and mantle, black bill, bright orange throat, breast and shoulders, white belly, white rump, pale wing bars

adult female, side view perched: grey-brown head with dark stripes along the sides of the crown and grey nape sides, paler orange-buff breast and shoulders, buff back spotted black, white belly, pale wing bars
art.build: Finch a little larger than a sparrow, longer-winged and slimmer-looking, usually feeding on the ground in flocks. Rounded head. Bill conical and pointed, much shorter than the head. Legs short, pinkish-brown. At rest the wingtips reach a little past the base of the tail. Tail medium length, black, distinctly notched. In flight the narrow white rump is the key mark, with orange shoulders and pale wing bars on black wings.
avoid: Do not paint a solid glossy black head and black bill on winter birds; that is the male's breeding plumage.
Do not paint the breast pinkish like a Common Chaffinch or pale buff; it is bright orange.
Do not omit the white rump.
Do not paint green tones or a heavy grosbeak bill.
